claims.statement: The completed Riemann xi-function satisfies xi(s)=xi(1-s).

the existence of a Hilbert-Polya operator

claims.statement: The completed xi-function packages zeta, Gamma(s/2), pi^{-s/2}, and the s(s-1) factor into an entire function; the trivial-zero/Gamma-pole structure is handled by this completion.
claims.role: Analytic normalization and separation of trivial-zero structure.
claims.metaphor_boundary: Calling this a polarizing aperture or frequency filter is architectural analogy, not a mathematical theorem.

establish the determinant class and normalization
